note: Edit this file to point the dashboard at your own CDP endpoints.

services.name: CDP Management Console
services.desc: Control plane: environments, data lakes, data hubs, COD.

services.name: Knox Gateway
services.desc: Single sign-on reverse proxy (HTTPS :443) in front of all cluster UIs/APIs.

services.name: FreeIPA
services.desc: Kerberos realm JKGEO-CD..., LDAP and DNS for the environment.

services.name: Cloudera Manager (Data Lake)
services.desc: Manage and monitor the SDX data lake services.

services.name: Apache Ranger
services.desc: Centralized authorization policies and audit (incl. HBase/Phoenix).

services.name: Apache Atlas
services.desc: Metadata catalog and data lineage/governance.

services.name: Hive Metastore
services.desc: Shared table metadata (HMS) used by Spark and SQL engines.

services.name: Iceberg table geo.geo_entity
services.desc: Apache Iceberg table in the Hive Metastore (SDX) on S3 (.../external/hive/geo.db/geo_entity). Same 476 features / 16 layers as HBase, ingested via Spark3 on the existing Data Hub (no new servers). Browse it on the Iceberg Table web page or query in Hue/Spark SQL.

services.name: Phoenix Query Server
services.desc: Avatica thin SQL endpoint (HTTPS/BASIC). Powers the spatial-SQL demo.

services.name: Hue (COD)
services.desc: Web SQL editor for Phoenix/HBase on COD.

services.name: Cloudera Manager (COD)
services.desc: Manage COD cluster services.

services.name: HBase
services.desc: Wide-column store (2.6.3). Table: GEO_ENTITY (476 features / 16 layers). ZooKeeper TLS :2182.

categories.name: Compute - Data Hub jkgeo-de (Spark3 Data Engineering)

services.name: Cloudera Manager (Data Hub)
services.desc: Manage the Data Engineering cluster (7.3.2). Note: Spark is the 'Spark 3' service (spark3_on_yarn) plus 'Livy for Spark 3' — there is no classic 'Spark' service on 7.x.

services.name: Spark 3 service (Cloudera Manager)
services.desc: Direct CM status page for the Spark 3 service (spark3_on_yarn). Runs on YARN — active jobs appear in YARN, completed jobs in the Spark 3 History Server.

services.name: YARN Resource Manager
services.desc: Spark 3 runs on YARN; running Spark applications show here.

services.name: Spark 3 History Server
services.desc: History/UI for completed Spark 3 jobs (e.g. the Iceberg ingest and Pi smoke test).

services.name: Amazon S3
services.desc: s3://jkgeo-cdp-bucket - data, Ranger audit (/jkgeo-dl/ranger/audit), logs.

services.name: Entity Map web app
services.desc: Flask + Leaflet map of the entity GeoJSON; publishes a GeoServer layer.

services.name: Iceberg Table (web)
services.desc: Tabular view of the Iceberg geo.geo_entity table (sort, filter, paginate).

services.name: Anomaly Storyboard (web)
services.desc: Multi-page demo walkthrough of trk-013's abnormal AIS pattern on the map and as visual-mode Iceberg charts.

services.name: Knowledge Graph (web)
services.desc: Ontology/graph view of the AIS anomaly data (Vessel, Mmsi, Flag, Region, AnomalyType ... linked by broadcasts/sharesIdentityWith/classifiedAs). Backed by an RDF/Turtle ontology at /api/graph/ontology.ttl.

services.name: GeoServer
services.desc: Optional OGC server (WMS/WFS). Run geoserver/publish_entity.sh to serve the entity data as direct layers; reachability shows up once it is running.
